project.name: PixelSight
project.objective: Deep Learning Based Super Resolution Mapping from Medium Resolution Satellite Imageries

p6_goal.description: Build a production-style frontend and backend application that allows users to upload compatible satellite imagery, run the real PixelSight super-resolution pipeline, visualize uncertainty, calculate valid evaluation metrics, and provide geospatial analysis features.
p6_goal.important_user_requirement: The frontend must accept user-uploaded satellite imagery and send it through the actual backend/model pipeline rather than only displaying precomputed project results.

validation: Never silently map arbitrary RGB bands into Sentinel-2 bands

super_resolution.scientific_warning: Do not describe the generated output as true observed 2.5m imagery.

evaluation.critical_rule: If no valid high-resolution reference is available, do not fabricate PSNR, SSIM, SAM, or any other reference-dependent metric.
evaluation.ui_behavior_without_reference: Clearly display that reference-based metrics are unavailable for this upload.

features: potential urban expansion/change indicators when suitable data exists
urban_planning.warning: Do not present these as validated operational urban-planning predictions unless corresponding ground truth exists.

features: crop-region analysis when suitable input data exists
crop_monitoring.warning: Do not claim crop monitoring accuracy without appropriate ground-truth validation.

features: before/after image comparison when two compatible images are provided
disaster_management.warning: Do not present this as a validated operational disaster-detection system without disaster-specific ground truth.

requirements: never allow arbitrary filesystem paths from the client
backend.large_scene_processing: Process large images in tiles and stitch outputs. Never attempt to place an entire 10980x10980 scene into a single GPU tensor.

scientific_guardrails: Never manipulate labels or test data.
Use the phrase '~2.5m equivalent super-resolved representation'.
Do not claim WorldCover is genuine 2.5m ground truth.
Do not claim the current LDSR model improves downstream segmentation.
Do not replace 100 steps with 10 steps.
Reuse existing research implementation whenever possible.
Do not rewrite working P2/P3/P4/P5 scripts unnecessarily.

copilot_workflow.phase_2: Identify existing frontend/backend and reusable research code.
copilot_workflow.phase_4: Wait for approval before large implementation.
copilot_workflow.phase_8: Test with a manageable satellite tile.

demo_strategy.description: The live demonstration should use a manageable satellite tile or region because full 10980x10980 LDSR-S2 inference is computationally expensive.
do_not: run the complete 10980x10980 scene during a live demo

copilot_rules: Do not assume React or FastAPI already exist.
Do not overwrite working research scripts.
Do not touch the held-out test set.
Keep research scripts separate from application integration code.
Report every file created or modified.
Provide exact commands to install, start, and test the application.
